Placeholder standing in for a label

This fixture documents a coverage gap, verified against axe-core 4.12.1 in Chromium rather than assumed.

A placeholder is a valid fallback name source in the accessible name computation, so axe's label rule passes on every field below. The best-practice label-title-only rule does not fire either — it covers title, not placeholder. A placeholder-only form is therefore reported clean by a default axe run.

It is still a real failure. The placeholder disappears the moment the field has content, so the user loses the label exactly when they need it to check their answer; it is not announced consistently across screen readers; it cannot be clicked to focus the field; and it is routinely styled at unreadable contrast. Placeholder-only forms are the single most common shape of the missing-label failure in AI-generated markup.
